source.cite: Service with the Sixth Wisconsin Volunteers (Rufus R. Dawes, 1890), Brevet Brig. Gen. Rufus R. Dawes (1890)

to.printed: our own breastworks on Gulp's Hill

note: "Here" is the breastworks the regiment had recaptured near General Greene.

statement: Dawes (1890): during the whole day of 3 July the Sixth Wisconsin occupied its intrenchments on Culp's Hill (printed Gulp's Hill), under sharpshooters' fire and the shells of the great cannonade, with no man touched.

source.author: Brevet Brig. Gen. Rufus R. Dawes
